name: 1password
description: Import passwords from 1Password export files. Supports both CSV (old and new formats) and 1PUX (ZIP archive) formats. 1Password vaults are mapped to categories.
author: PasswordManager Team

configuration.vaultMapping: 1Password vaults are mapped to categories in the Password Manager

help.instructions: Export your 1Password data as CSV or 1PUX format. For 1PUX imports, vault names will be mapped to categories. Both old (pre-2023) and new (2023+) CSV formats are supported.
exportSteps: 2. Select the vault you want to export
3. Go to File > Export > All Items
5. For CSV: Both old and new export formats are supported automatically
6. For 1PUX: Vault names will become categories in Password Manager
